mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey where the way we eat unlocks stories about our health, our communities, and even our future. Imagine standing on a mountainside in a remote village, watching generations thrive on foods their ancestors knew by heart—then picture the busy city streets, where new habits and modern diets quietly shape the lives of millions. Together, we’re about to explore the fascinating world illuminated in Nutrition and Physical Degeneration, guided by the careful observations of Weston A. Price. What happens when traditional, nutrient-rich foods give way to processed convenience? The answers are more surprising—and more important—than you might think. As we follow stories from distant communities to the heart of bustling cities, we’ll see patterns unfold: strong teeth and vibrant health where ancestral diets remain, and the quiet rise of chronic health struggles as modern foods take over. These discoveries invite us to pause and ask: what wisdom from the past might help us restore vitality today? So, as we set out together, get ready to question what you know about food, tradition, and the very foundations of well-being. Let’s dive in, and see what’s really at stake in the choices we make every day.
